theorems.name: Submission.imsupp_measure_eq_zero_of_vanishesOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → R.measure W = 0
